msg: Knomes with a red, purple, brown or red hat will give you a red basket, Knomes with a yellow, green or blue hat with give a yellow basket. I found that I went with the knomes that gave me a red basket first and when it appeared that I was not receiving as many mushrooms as I had before, I would switch to Knomes with the yellow basket. If you are not sure if it is a good time to switch or not, I would test this only on the x1 multiply rounds if switching to the Knomes with the different coloured basket gave me a higher number of mushrooms I would switch, if not, I would carry on with the colour I had for a bit longer. Good Luck!
